pattern_summary: Dominant errors: strain_reported (7/10) from node2c invitro bleed-through and animal/vendor stacking on synthetic-only in-vivo papers; species (6/10) populated on mixed in-vitro-primary papers; duration_days/sample_size/administration_frequency/thc_mg_kg missed or spurious from cell-culture context; exposure_method over-stacks routes; review misrouting when PDF Methods omit in-vivo intro cues.
implementation_notes: Mixed cell-culture + animal ethics papers return null strain/species/duration when no in-vivo dosing cues.
In-vivo synthetic/cultivar priority path returns CP-55,940/WIN/O-1602 panels or Skywalker/Treasure Island profiles without animal vendor noise.
Administration frequency normalizes whitespace and twice-a-week; sample_size takes max N; duration_days skips incubation windows.
Exposure routing prefers whole-body chamber over nose-only; drops clinical inhaled/oral duplicates on animal routes.
Publication routing uses full PDF text prefix so prenatal/primate in-vivo papers are not misclassified as reviews.
Full-PDF fallback for duration_days, administration_frequency, sample_size, thc_mg_kg on in-vivo batches.
